ev.q: a trap based action-tower defense video game
The game has emphasis on co-operative gameplay as the principal addition over the original
the player is given time to recover and place additional traps
the player selects a number of traps, spells, and equipment from their Spellbook
Skulls are used to improve traps and equipment
the players must hold off forty waves of orcs from all the various types in the game
called it a fun and quirky title
